title: I made a Danganronpa-inspired murder mystery visual novel in Ren'Py using AI. Looking for honest, critical feedback on the prologue!
author: DarkStoryLab
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I just released the free prologue for my fan visual novel, **Danganronpa: Ultimate Liar**. I have large parts of Chapter 1 already written, but I want to get real, honest feedback on the prologue first before deciding whether to finish the rest of the project.

**The Premise:**

Sixteen students are trapped together as supplies like food, clean water, and air run out. Unlike the original games, their memories were never wiped—they still remember their close friendships from Hope's Peak. When murder is the only way out, can those bonds survive?

**My Workflow:**

* **Writing:** I wrote the core story and script myself, using AI as an assistant for brainstorming and scene drafting.
* **Art:** Since I cannot draw, all character sprites and backgrounds were generated using AI.
* **Engine:** Built in Ren'Py.

**What I Need Feedback On:**

1. **The Writing & Tone:** Does the dialogue feel natural, or does it sound stiff or repetitive?
2. **Visual Consistency:** Do the AI-generated sprites, scenes, and backgrounds fit together well enough, or do they pull you out of the story?
3. **The Hook:** Does the prologue make you actually want to play Chapter 1?

You can play it directly in your browser or download it for PC, Mac, or Android here:

[**https://darkstorylab.itch.io/danganronpa-ultimate-liar**](https://darkstorylab.itch.io/danganronpa-ultimate-liar)

Don't hold back on your feedback! I appreciate the brutal honesty!
